content:
Any longtime 9to5Toys reader knows how much we love Nomad. The brand has been producing some of the best iPhone cases in the industry for years now, and its new lineup for this year's iPhone 18 Pro series is no exception. However, discounts on new releases are rare during the first few months — unless you use our exclusive Nomad promo code: enter 9TO5MAC at checkout to take 15% off any of its new iPhone 18 Pro cases.

Nomad iPhone 18 Pro cases with exclusive discount code

***Note: Enter promo code 9TO5MAC at checkout to receive the exclusive pricing below. This offer applies only to iPhone 18 Pro/Max cases and does not include the iPhone Duo.

  • Modern Leather Case – $58 (regularly $69)
  • Modern Horween Leather Case – $67 (regularly $79)
  • Traditional Leather Case – $67 (regularly $79)
  • Traditional Horween Leather Case – $75 (regularly $89)
  • Mag Leather Backplate – $50 (regularly $59)
  • Rugged Case – $58 (regularly $69)
  • Clear Leather Case – $58 (regularly $69)
  • Sport Case – $46 (regularly $55)

Just a heads-up: when purchasing most Nomad cases, you can also add a screen protector to your cart for an additional 20% off. Just make sure they're in the same cart.

Personally, I'm a big fan of Nomad's Traditional Leather Case, with leather that wraps all the way around the sides, as well as the two-tone Modern Leather option. This year I've also had a chance to try out its limited-edition Bordeaux special edition that pairs perfectly with the iPhone 18 Pro — and as always, it's fantastic.

Nomad has also introduced an all-new Rugged Case this year, featuring a unique design inspired by a topographic map of Baja California — and it looks far better in person than on the website:

For a closer look at the full lineup of Nomad's 2026 iPhone 18 Pro cases, be sure to check out our hands-on coverage — and don't forget to bring the promo code above along with you.
